newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Soyuz capsule with two Russian cosmonauts lands.
newsitem.headline: Soyuz capsule with two Russian cosmonauts lands.

text.p: A Soyuz spacecraft with two Russian cosmonauts returning from the Mir space station after a most difficult six months mission landed in Kazakhstan's steppe on Thursday, Mission Control said.
Applause burst out in Mission Control outside Moscow where officials and experts had been awaiting the landing in tense silence.
The landing was apparently delayed by slightly more than one minute.
